ITA-9.2.34 talaṁ तलम्
Medicated paste or oil applied over vertex
An application of warm oil mixed with powder and made into a paste (or only warm oil) placed over the vertex.

ITA-3.16.31 talahṛdayam (marma) तलहृदयम् (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) on the midpoint of sole and palm
Four in number (one in each limb) which when injured leads to pain which ends in death.

ITA-9.6.10 tālayantram तालयन्त्रम्
Spatula, spoonshaped instruments
Scoop-like instruments used in surgical and parasurgical procedures such as removal of foreign bodies from the ears, nostrils, and other passages.

.23 tālu तालु
Palate
A term which denotes the anterior fontanelle.

ITA-5.63.43 tālu-arbudaḥ तालु-अर्बुदः
Tumour of palate
A disorder characterized by a lotus-shaped swelling in the centre of the palate.

ITA-5.71.4 tālukaṇṭakaḥ तालुकण्टकः
Dehydration of palate
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: depression/sinking of anterior fontanelle; depression of palate; aversion to breast milk; difficulty in sucking; loose stools; thirst; itching in mouth; pain in eyes; inability to hold neck; vomiting.

ITA-5.63.37 tālugatarogaḥ तालुगतरोगः
Disorders of palate
A disorder impacting on the structure and/or function of the interior upper surface (roof) of the mouth.

ITA-5.63.47 tālupākaḥ/ tāluśothaḥ तालुपाकः/तालुशोथः
Palatal inflammation
A disorder characterized by excessive suppuration/ inflammation of the palate; pus discharge; severe pain.

ITA-5.63.48 tālupiḍakā तालुपिडका
Palatal boil
A disorder characterized by painful soft tissue in the palate; eruption in palatal soft tissue; rough eruptions; multiple eruptions; eruptions with thick exudation.

ITA-5.63.45 tālupuppuṭaḥ तालुपुप्पुटः
Cystic swelling of palate
A disorder characterized by a painless swelling in the middle of the palate; painless swelling in palate; stable/benign swelling in palate.

.24 tāludeśaḥ, tālupradeśaḥ तालुदेशः, तालुप्रदेशः
Region of palate

.25 tālumāṃsam तालुमांसम्
Soft palate
A term which denotes the anterior fontanelle.

ITA-5.63.49 tāluvidradhiḥ तालुविद्रधिः
Palatal abscess
A disorder characterized by a burning sensation in the palate; redness/congestion of palate; inflammation/ suppuration of palate.

ITA-5.63.46 tāluśoṣaḥ तालुशोषः
Atrophy of palate
A disorder characterized by excessive dryness of the palate; fever; exertion; fissuring of palate; respiratory distress.

ITA-3.13.14 tālvasthi ताल्वस्थि
Bones of the palate
